content.title: Home Page - UC Irvine Graduate Division
content.text: Studying at UCI means having real-world impact. Thrive with our inclusive community of faculty and students who value both intellect and imagination. Find the space for your fearless academic pursuits, here. UCI offers over 120 graduate degree programs that are among the best in the country in each field of study, with 32 doctoral programs ranked within the top 25 among public universities nationally, according to the U.S. News & World Report (2021) Just starting to think about graduate school? Meet with staff during a 15-minute one-on-one meeting to gain more insight on exploring programs and applying. See what it takes to be a graduate student at UC Irvine! Meet with one of our knowledgeable graduate recruiters today! From housing and financial aid to wellness resources, UCI offers extensive support to ensure your success. Click here to learn more about the student services available to you. Each year, close to 5,000 graduate students attend the UCI and approximately 1,500 master’s and doctoral degrees are conferred across more than 90 academic programs. Hear from our students and alumni who made the choice to join UCI. Located in sunny Southern California, our scenic campus sits on 1,474 acres of lush, rolling hills just a few miles from the sparkling Pacific Ocean and borders the majestic beach cities of Laguna and Newport Beach. With state-of-the-art research facilities, vibrant student life, and abundant natural beauty, UCI offers the perfect environment to grow, thrive and achieve success in your graduate journey. On and off campus, you have access to unmatched cultural, recreational, and professional opportunities that will enrich both your academic journey and your personal growth At UCI, we take pride in being a Leader in Inclusive Excellence. Our campus thrives with an inclusive student body, welcoming individuals from every state in the U.S. and over 65 countries, representing a wide range of interests, backgrounds, and experiences- reflecting a truly global community. We are committed to creating an environment where every individual feels valued and empowered. Recognized for our exceptional commitment to inclusivity, UCI ranks first for inclusivity in the 2019 Wall Street Journal/Times Higher Education rankings and No. 3 for inclusivity among Top Colleges in the West. Our dedication ensures that all voices are heard, and varied perspectives are integrated into our academic and community life. Join us and be part of a university that not only celebrates inclusivity but actively fosters an inclusive and enriching educational experience for everyone.
